title: Run a function, then wait for Enter

origin.description: Call fun, then readline so the next expression waits.
origin.usage: make_blocking(fun, msg = "Press ENTER to continue...", invisible.res = TRUE)

arguments.name: invisible.res
arguments.text: When TRUE, the result is invisible. The example sets it to FALSE so the sum prints.

origin.details: Under Rscript, readline does not prompt and does not wait. sum(1:10) is 55.

translation.description: Call fun, then input when stdin is a terminal.
translation.usage: make_blocking(fun, msg="Press ENTER to continue...", invisible_res=True)

arguments.name: invisible_res
arguments.text: Accepted for the R argument. The return value is always returned; printing it is up to the caller.

translation.details: A non-terminal stdin skips the prompt, matching Rscript. sum(range(1, 11)) is 55.
translation.example:
from diffobj import make_blocking
print(make_blocking(sum, invisible_res=False)(range(1, 11)))

name: make_blocking
